lifecycle.retention: Keep the local immutable contract and the current shared asset identity until a new contract is accepted.

value.goal: Remote underlay refresh depends on an agreed new server specification.
value.implementation: Local underlays retain the immutable_local contract and shared asset references. The manual Debug import is a separate path.
value.source_verification: A future specification needs manifest, version and hash checks and an atomic replacement plan. Existing local import evidence covers its own archive and cache.
value.merge: The shared asset and local import route is in the adopted source. Server refresh remains pending specification.
value.runtime_verification: Verify incomplete download, rollback and retained active project references after authorization.
value.release: A remote update release follows the specification and separately verified client compatibility.
